name: Frigate
short_description: AI-powered NVR with real-time object detection for IP cameras.
description: Frigate is a self-hosted NVR built around real-time AI object detection. It uses your CPU or GPU to detect people, vehicles, and animals in camera streams, storing recordings and sending alerts only when relevant events occur — keeping storage lean and notifications meaningful.
usecases: Monitor IP cameras with AI-based person and vehicle detection.
Record only relevant events to save disk space.
Integrate camera events with Home Assistant for smart automations.
notes: A config.yml file is required in the frigate_config volume before first startup.
For hardware acceleration, pass your GPU device (e.g., /dev/dri/renderD128) via compose.
